# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in contributing! 

## Reporting bugs

Open a [PR](https://github.com/h8d13/caesar/pulls) (or an [issue](https://github.com/h8d13/caesar/issues)) with a clear title, steps to reproduce bug/fix, and what you expected vs. what happened.

Or describe what you are trying to improve. Screenshots also welcome.

## Pull requests
1. Fork the repo and create a branch off `master`.
`git checkout -b mynewfeature`
2. Make your changes; keep commits focused on key files.
3. Run `pnpm magic` for lint, format, tests. You can also use `pre-commit install` from repo root.
4. Open a PR

Review will be **within 24h.**

## Style
- Follow the existing code style. Comments are welcome when not explicit through code.
- Depending on scope: Add tests for new behavior.

By contributing, you agree to abide by our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
